g.text: Live on App Store and Google Play
Party games for iPhone and Android. Seven games,
played on one phone or everyone on their own, plus
a mode that hosts the whole night with one shared
leaderboard. Designed, built and shipped solo.
Realtime rooms on Supabase, host-authoritative state
Network simulator: virtual phones, packet loss, clock skew
Postgres RLS covered by pgTAP, payments via RevenueCat
OTA releases on EAS, Sentry and PostHog in production
